description: LICENCE (sold on the Influence plan) — the WHOLE dataset, not a 100-row page: `ratings` (every rated provider with facets, trend, rubric + provenance), `providers` (the catalog with coverage + score), or `history` (every provider's full score time series — parallel date/composite/agent_readiness arrays across every scored build the catalog retains, with a movement summary per provider). `history` is the one nobody can reconstruct after the fact: it is the only record of what the catalog looked like on those dates. For media outlets and analysts licensing the data to publish rankings and trends. Every dataset exceeds one response, so they arrive in byte-budgeted chunks: while `complete` is false, call again with `cursor` set to `next_cursor` and concatenate `data`; the last page has `complete: true` and a null `next_cursor`. Attribute to apis.io and cite the rubric. Priced B3 (bulk export) — $0.002 per row, $0.50 minimum per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

co_brand.description: Optional partner name for a co-branded license — stamps the attribution the license carries.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

cursor.description: Resume offset from a previous response's next_cursor. Omit for the first page; keep calling while next_cursor is not null.
